title: Bias-Reduced and Parallel Heavy-Tailed Stochastic Convex Optimization in $\ell_p$ Geometries
abstract: arXiv:2611.21844v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider the fundamental problem of parallel stochastic convex optimization (SCO), whose aim is to approximately minimize a convex objective when given the ability to query a moment-bounded stochastic gradient oracle multiple times in parallel per round. Whereas most previous results have focused on the variance-bounded Euclidean ($\ell_2$-norm) setting, meaning the objective is Lipschitz with respect to the $\ell_2$-norm over an $\ell_2$-bounded feasible set in $\mathbb{R}^d$, in this work we study parallel SCO in $\ell_p$ settings for $2 \le p < \infty$ under a heavy-tailed noise model. We begin by introducing a new class of $\ell_p$-optimal-distance-convergence (ODC$_p$) algorithms, drawing on prior stochastic bias-reduced techniques [ACJ+21], which combine with multilevel Monte Carlo methods to efficiently estimate the optimum of uniformly convex objectives. translated_title: ℓ_p 几何下去偏差与并行化的重尾随机凸优化
translated_abstract: 我们考虑并行随机凸优化（SCO）这一基本问题，其目标是在每一轮可以多次并行查询矩有界的随机梯度预言机的条件下，近似最小化一个凸目标函数。以往的大多数结果都集中在方差有界的欧几里得（ℓ_2 范数）设定上，即目标函数在 ℝ^d 中 ℓ_2 有界的可行域上关于 ℓ_2 范数是 Lipschitz 的；而本工作则研究重尾噪声模型下 2 ≤ p < ∞ 的 ℓ_p 设定中的并行随机凸优化。我们首先引入了一类新的 ℓ_p 最优距离收敛（ODC_p）算法，借鉴了先前的随机去偏差技术 [ACJ+21]，该算法与多层蒙特卡罗方法相结合，可以高效地估计一致凸目标函数的最优值。作为 ODC_p 算法的结果，我们首先建立了相应速率……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文在重尾噪声模型下研究 ℓ_p 几何中的并行随机凸优化，提出了一类结合随机去偏差技术与多层蒙特卡罗方法的新颖 ODC_p 算法，可高效估计一致凸目标函数的最优值并给出相应的收敛速率。
en_tdlr: This paper studies parallel stochastic convex optimization in ℓ_p geometries under heavy-tailed noise, introducing a new class of ODC_p algorithms that combine stochastic bias-reduction techniques with multilevel Monte Carlo methods to efficiently estimate the optimum of uniformly convex objectives with improved convergence rates.
